why.title: Why Oman Compass Tours
why.description: Ten years of guiding, one promise: you see the real Oman, safely, comfortably and at your own pace.

hidden.title: Hidden gems
hidden.body: Go beyond the usual sights to places known mainly to locals: quiet wadis, mountain villages and family homes that make your journey truly your own.

guides.title: Local expertise, authentic experiences
guides.body: Born-and-raised Omani guides share the culture, traditions, history and everyday life of Oman while you explore its landscapes safely.

comfort.title: Comfort, safety and convenience
comfort.body: Modern air-conditioned 4WD vehicles, professional guidance at every step, and complimentary Wi-Fi on selected multi-day tours.

flexible.title: Flexible and fully private
flexible.body: Every departure is yours alone. Adjust the itinerary, add a destination or change the pace; the trip follows your interests and schedule.

service.title: Personal care, start to finish
service.body: Clear communication before you book, WhatsApp support during the trip and a team that stays in touch afterwards, in English and Arabic.

pricing.title: Fair, transparent pricing
pricing.body: Prices in line with the Omani market with no hidden charges: the value you pay for is the quality, safety and comfort you get.

about.metaDescription: Omani-owned, licensed by the Ministry of Heritage & Tourism, rated 5.0 on Tripadvisor. Meet the team and fleet behind our private tours.
about.title: Omani-owned. Ten years on the road.
about.story1: Oman Compass Tours Company was founded in Muscat by Omanis who grew up between the coast and the mountains and wanted visitors to experience the country the way locals do: privately, unhurried, and with real hospitality.
about.story2: Today we are a fully licensed operator (Ministry of Heritage & Tourism licence no. 1440944) with our own fleet of 4WD vehicles and buses, a team of certified guides and drivers, and more than 70 five-star reviews that place us first among 46 experiences in Muscat on Tripadvisor.
about.story3: Every itinerary is customisable, most tours carry free cancellation, and our guests are treated as guests — with coffee, dates and time to talk.
about.imageAlt: Oman Compass Tours guides with guests
about.mission: To show every guest the authentic Oman — its landscapes, its people and its traditions — safely, comfortably and with pride.
about.vision: To be the most trusted name for private and luxury travel in the Sultanate, known for guides who become friends.

authenticity.title: Authenticity
authenticity.body: Real villages, real families, real food — never staged.

safety.title: Safety
safety.body: Certified drivers, maintained 4WDs and weather-aware planning in every wadi.

hospitality.title: Hospitality
hospitality.body: You are our guest before you are our customer.

sustainability.title: Respect
sustainability.body: Small groups, local partners and strict animal-welfare standards.

about.teamDescription: Licensed Omani guides and drivers who know every track — Musab is the name you will see most often in our reviews.
